caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a wooden chair or seat with a high backrest, colored in shades of green. The chair has a rounded seat and a slightly curved back that rises above the seat itself. The wood grain and texture are visible, suggesting a solid, carved structure. There are decorative elements painted on the chair: on the upper right section of the backrest, there are red flowers with green stems and leaves; a similar motif, with red floral elements, is found on the lower front of the seat. Additionally, a yellow and black flower is present on the lower left front of the seat, accompanied by white and red tulip-like patterns. There is a criss-cross pattern band that runs horizontally around the upper portion of the chair, just below the seat. The drawing uses subtle shading to give the chair a three-dimensional appearance, and the background is plain and neutral, with no other objects or details.
title: Child's stool chair
